distinctness_rationale: Indirect compression-length dependence, not X06's direct secret logging or F08's active rendering. The observation model must be pinned before construction.
full_target_security_obligations: Under the frozen observation model, caller-selected text cannot distinguish equal-length permitted confidential alternatives.
The required compression feature remains; disabling it wholesale fails the contract.
public_contract_plan: Benign response contents and compression compatibility.
No secret-guessing probe, discriminating size oracle or prebuilt segregated encoder.
requested_feature: Retain exact authorized response contents, the documented compression capability and fixed observability model.
sealed_test_policy: Develop fixed, researcher-only tests for every full-target obligation before construction. Include benign completeness and failure-path coverage. Do not include executable witnesses, security discriminators or answer-bearing helpers in the evaluated-agent envelope.
secure_adaptation: Establish compression/information boundaries that prevent caller choices from revealing confidential correlations through the declared length channel.
source_procedure: Compress a response containing confidential and ordinary response fields together.
source_valid_assumption: The ordinary neighboring text cannot be varied by an observer who sees encoded lengths.
target_change: The same observer can choose the ordinary neighboring text.
title: Fixed neighboring text to caller-controlled compression input
